description: This pie chart details the distribution of articles across various media outlets, as presented in the study “Narrative Media Framing in Political Discourse.” The chart contains fourteen distinct slices representing different news sources, plus a combined “Other” category, for a total of fifteen categories. The slices are labeled “Breitbart” (grey, 14%), “Shareblue” (dark grey, 13%), “Other” (light grey, 8%), “The Daily Caller” (green, 8%), “Drudge Report” (teal, 8%), “NPR” (purple, 7%), “Vox” (red, 6%), “The Guardian” (peach, 5%), “BBC” (yellow, 5%), “RT” (blue, 3%), “Daily Kos” (light blue, 3%), “National Review” (salmon, 3%), “Daily Beast” (brown, 3%), “Fox News” (orange, 3%), and “PoliticusUSA” (burgundy, 3%). Percentage values are displayed within each slice. The segments appear ordered clockwise by descending size, starting with “Breitbart.” A legend is not present on the chart.
